# ARRI Frameline XML Format Specification

Reference documentation based on analysis of the official ARRI Frame Line Tool (FLT-5.3.6) at https://tools.arri.com/flt/index.html

## XML Structure

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- Generated by FLT-5.3.x -->
<!-- (metadata comments: camera model, format, resolution, sensor area) -->

<framelines>
  <camera>
    <type>ALEXA Mini</type>        <!-- Camera model name -->
    <sensor>3K</sensor>            <!-- Sensor mode identifier -->
    <aspect>1.33</aspect>          <!-- Recording format aspect ratio -->
    <hres>2880</hres>              <!-- Horizontal recording resolution (pixels) -->
    <vres>2160</vres>              <!-- Vertical recording resolution (pixels) -->
  </camera>

  <surround>
    <opacity>0</opacity>           <!-- Surround view opacity (0 = off) -->
  </surround>

  <!-- Rectangles: shading bars, blackouts, center markers -->
  <rect>...</rect>

  <!-- Frameline name labels -->
  <framelineName framelineRect="formatA">Name</framelineName>

  <!-- Lines: edges of frameline boxes -->
  <line framelineRect="formatA">...</line>
</framelines>
```

## Coordinate System

All position values are **normalized 0.0–1.0**, representing **inset distances from their respective edges** (NOT absolute positions):

| Element   | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| `<top>`   | Distance from the **top** edge, as fraction of total vertical resolution |
| `<bottom>`| Distance from the **bottom** edge, as fraction of total vertical resolution |
| `<left>`  | Distance from the **left** edge, as fraction of total horizontal resolution |
| `<right>` | Distance from the **right** edge, as fraction of total horizontal resolution |

### Converting to pixel positions

Given a canvas of size `W x H`:

```
x1 = left * W          (left edge of area)
y1 = top * H           (top edge of area)
x2 = W - (right * W)   (right edge of area)
y2 = H - (bottom * H)  (bottom edge of area)
```

### How inset values are calculated

Values are purely pixel-based, normalized to clip resolution. Physical sensor dimensions don't enter the calculation.

```
inset_normalized = ((vres - (hres / target_aspect)) / 2) / vres
```

Example — 1.85:1 frameline on ALEXA Mini 4:3 2.8K (2880x2160):
```
((2160 - (2880 / 1.85)) / 2) / 2160 = ((2160 - 1556.76) / 2) / 2160 = 0.1398
```

The same 1.85:1 target on a 16:9 format (e.g., 3840x2160) yields a much smaller inset because 1.78:1 is close to 1.85:1.

## Rect Elements

Rectangles are used for shading overlays, corner blackouts, and center markers.

```xml
<rect>
  <top>0</top>
  <bottom>0.875</bottom>
  <left>0</left>
  <right>0</right>
  <border>
    <width>0</width>
    <color>black</color>
  </border>
  <fill>
    <color>black</color>
    <opacity>0.50</opacity>
  </fill>
</rect>
```

### Shading pattern for a Full Box frameline

A frameline with shading generates **4 rects** forming bars around the frameline area:

| Rect        | top   | bottom | left | right | Purpose |
|-------------|-------|--------|------|-------|---------|
| Top bar     | 0     | ~0.86  | 0    | 0     | From top edge down to frameline top |
| Bottom bar  | ~0.86 | 0      | 0    | 0     | From frameline bottom to bottom edge |
| Left bar    | ~0.14 | ~0.14  | 0    | 1     | Left column within frameline height |
| Right bar   | ~0.14 | ~0.14  | 1    | 0     | Right column within frameline height |

The left/right bars use `left=0, right=1` and `left=1, right=0` respectively, which produces zero-width rects (placeholders).

### Opacity values

| Opacity | Visual |
|---------|--------|
| `1.0`   | Fully opaque black — complete blackout |
| `0.50`  | 50% transparent — medium shading |
| `0.25`  | 25% transparent — light shading |
| `0.00`  | Invisible (used for center marker dots with "user" color) |

### Corner blackouts

For combined framelines (e.g., 16:9 + 9:16), the areas outside both framelines get 4 corner blackout rects with `opacity=1.0`. Each covers one corner of the sensor area bounded by the two frameline edges.

## Line Elements

Lines form the visible edges of frameline boxes.

```xml
<line framelineRect="formatA">
  <top>0.125</top>
  <left>0</left>
  <right>0</right>
  <width>4</width>
  <color>user</color>
</line>
```

### Determining line orientation

**Critical: absent elements and zero-value elements have different meanings.**

An element that is **absent** (not in the XML) means the line does not use that axis for positioning. An element **present with value 0** means the line is positioned at that edge.

| Pattern | Type | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| `<top>` present, `<bottom>` **absent** | Horizontal | Line at the top inset, spanning left to right |
| `<bottom>` present, `<top>` **absent** | Horizontal | Line at the bottom inset, spanning left to right |
| `<top>` + `<bottom>` both present, `<left>` present, `<right>` **absent** | Vertical | Line at the left inset, spanning top to bottom |
| `<top>` + `<bottom>` both present, `<right>` present, `<left>` **absent** | Vertical | Line at the right inset, spanning top to bottom |

### Full Box example (4 lines)

```xml
<!-- Top horizontal -->    <top>0.096</top> <left>0</left> <right>0</right>
<!-- Bottom horizontal --> <bottom>0.096</bottom> <left>0</left> <right>0</right>
<!-- Left vertical -->     <top>0.096</top> <bottom>0.096</bottom> <left>0</left>
<!-- Right vertical -->    <top>0.096</top> <bottom>0.096</bottom> <right>0</right>
```

### Corner style (8 lines — L-shaped hash marks)

Corner markers use partial spans (e.g., `right=0.9` limits a horizontal tick to 10% of the width):

```xml
<!-- Left-top horizontal tick -->   <left>0</left> <right>0.9</right> <top>0.125</top>
<!-- Right-top horizontal tick -->  <left>0.9</left> <right>0</right> <top>0.125</top>
<!-- Top-left vertical tick -->     <left>0</left> <top>0.125</top> <bottom>0.8</bottom>
<!-- Top-right vertical tick -->    <right>0</right> <top>0.125</top> <bottom>0.8</bottom>
<!-- (+ 4 more for bottom corners) -->
```

### Color values

| Value | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `"user"` | User-selectable in camera menu at runtime. Default display color: green |
| `"green"`, `"white"`, `"red"`, etc. | Fixed color |

### Width

`<width>` is in pixels at the camera's native recording resolution (e.g., `4` = 4px at 2880x2160). Scale proportionally when rendering at different sizes.

## Multiple Frameline Formats

A single XML can contain multiple frameline formats (formatA, formatB, formatC). Each has:
- Its own set of `<rect>` elements for shading
- A `<framelineName framelineRect="formatX">` label
- Its own set of `<line>` elements with `framelineRect="formatX"` attributes

## FLT URL Preservation

The official tool embeds a full reconstruction URL in an XML comment (starting with `<!-- Frame Line URL: https://tools.arri.com/flt/index.html?... -->`). This allows reopening the exact configuration in the FLT web tool.
